F1.name: Split Temperature
F1.cross_surface_coherence: PASS — APP and WEB clearly share the same warm/cool hinge while WEB gains only modest expressive warmth.
F1.distinctiveness: MODERATE — the cool ink against restrained earth accent is legible as a system, but its character is not difficult to find elsewhere.
F1.genericity: RESERVATION — premium editorial, heritage and warm-earth product grammars remain materially available readings.
F1.calm_low_fatigue: PASS — quiet field and restrained accent remain comfortable at wide and 320 widths.
F1.semantic_honesty: PASS — the warm accent does not inherently read as success/error/status in this neutral carrier.
F1.fallback_resilience: PASS — forced-colors evidence preserves structure and action.

F2.name: Monochrome + Intruder
F2.cross_surface_coherence: PASS — subdued violet-neutral structure and rare teal interruption remain recognizably the same logic across APP and WEB.
F2.distinctiveness: STRONGEST OF THE FOUR — identity comes from chroma scarcity and one controlled exception rather than simply choosing a saturated brand hue.
F2.genericity: PASS WITH WATCH — violet/teal creative-tool familiarity exists, but the restrained distribution and rarity mechanism is materially less conventional than CCONV and F4.
F2.calm_low_fatigue: PASS — broad low-chroma surfaces dominate; teal remains sparse enough not to agitate the carrier.
F2.semantic_honesty: PASS — teal is consistently non-status emphasis here and no content meaning depends on it.
F2.fallback_resilience: PASS — forced-colors evidence preserves structure and action without candidate color.

F3.name: Complementary Poles
F3.cross_surface_coherence: PASS — green-tinted structure and plum accent remain consistent across surfaces.
F3.distinctiveness: MODERATE — the polarity is visible but reads primarily as a familiar palette relationship rather than a uniquely attributable logic.
F3.genericity: FAIL IN DESIGN-SOL VIEW — botanical/wellness/natural-product readings are too readily available.
F3.calm_low_fatigue: PASS mechanically and visually, but the green field has stronger category affect than the neutral fixture warrants.
F3.semantic_honesty: RESERVATION — green-family structural color increases future collision pressure with conventional positive/success semantics even though this specimen encodes no status.

F4.name: Chromatic Ladder
F4.cross_surface_coherence: PASS — the blue ladder survives APP/WEB adaptation coherently.
F4.distinctiveness: WEAK — the warm field does not overcome the dominant familiar blue-product grammar.
F4.genericity: FAIL IN DESIGN-SOL VIEW — compared directly with CCONV, F4 remains too close to conventional SaaS/product-blue signaling in the accent, boundary and soft-surface ladder.

recommendation.secondary: F1 — Split Temperature, retained only with explicit genericity reservation
